thread.title: Brian Strickland shares personal milestones and campaign updates in recent posts

author: A. B. Hutchings
title: Brian Strickland shares personal milestones and campaign updates in recent posts
text:
Brian Strickland, a Republican candidate for Georgia Attorney General and current state senator representing the 42nd Senate District, has recently shared updates on his social media account regarding both personal and political matters.
On April 13, 2026, Strickland posted a message celebrating his wife’s birthday: “She’s the glue that keeps it all together. It makes all the difference to have a partner who stands by your side every step of the way. The boys and I are truly blessed to have her! Join me in wishing my wife, Lindsay, a very happy birthday!”
The following day, on April 14, 2026, Strickland commented on his participation at a local political event: “It was a pleasure joining the Jackson County GOP for their meeting last week! I enjoyed the opportunity to share our vision for the Attorney General’s office, talk about the importance of law and order, and hear directly from voters about the issues that matter most to their”
On April 15, 2026, Strickland reflected on an encounter with Vice President JD Vance during Turning Point USA’s “This is the Turning Point” tour. He also addressed concerns about political violence: “It was an honor to see Vice President @JDVance at @TPUSA’s This is the Turning Point tour. Unfortunately, Erika Kirk wasn’t able to make it because of significant threats she received. Political violence and intimidation have no place in Georgia. As your next Attorney General, I”
Strickland began serving as state senator for Georgia’s 42nd Senate District in 2025 after succeeding Elena Parent.
